messages:
sasha-sales: Quick sync — TwinLabs is ready to sign the POC order but there are three procurement asks:
- split billing across 'TwinLabs US, Inc.' and 'TwinLabs EU GmbH'
- net-60 payment terms for the POC invoice
- 10% holdback until production go-live

They also pushed a DPA redline (data residence clause) and want KMS/HSM proof for key custody. Can legal + finance advise on the fastest path? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

julie-legal: Thanks. Can you attach the counterparty legal names and the exact DPA clause they redlined? If they want a holdback, we need to map it in the order form and confirm SLA acceptance criteria. Also, KMS proof — we can provide an attestation doc but not HSM export keys.

ryan-finance: Net-60 on a POC is unusual but possible with exec approval. Need to know billing amounts and which entity signs the PO. Does TwinLabs expect two invoices (one per entity) or a single invoice with cost center split? :thinking_face:

omar-ops: From infra side — if they want EU-managed keys or private deployment for data locality, that affects pricing and timeline. If it's just KMS integration (cloud KMS) we can sign off quickly; on-prem HSM will add 2-4 weeks.

sasha-sales: Good points. Attaching the draft order form snippet they sent (pasted below). They expect us to fill billing_entity and invoice_split fields. They also want the SLA checkbox tied to go-live acceptance test pass.

sasha-sales: ```json
{
  "customer": "TwinLabs",
  "billing_entities": [
    {"name": "TwinLabs US, Inc.", "percentage": 60},
    {"name": "TwinLabs EU GmbH", "percentage": 40}
  ],
  "payment_terms": "NET_60",
  "holdback": {"percent": 10, "release_condition": "production_go_live"},
  "kms": "customer_managed",
  "dpa_clause": "data_residency_eu_only"
}
```

julie-legal: OK — propose this approach:
1) We return a single MSA + Order Form where billing_entities is informational; invoices will be issued to TwinLabs US, Inc. by default unless they provide legal PO per EU entity.
2) Add an explicit holdback appendix that defines acceptance test and timeline for release (e.g., holdback released within 30 days of go-live verification).
3) For DPA redline: counter-propose a scoped residency (processed in EU region for EU-subset of data) rather than full export ban.
I can draft language and send as redline. :writing_hand:

ryan-finance: If we go single-invoice default, we'll need a billing contact and VAT handling note for EU. Also, net-60 requires credit check or an approved credit note from sales ops. Can ops provide the expected contract value?

omar-ops: Estimated POC spend ~ $48k (2 nodes reserved for 3 months + ingress). If they insist on private deployment for EU keys, add $12k one-time setup. That puts total ~ $60k. Will flag SLA acceptance criteria with ENG for measurable tests (p99 latency under X, inference accuracy baseline, integration smoke tests).

deploy-bot: Order form draft uploaded to /files/TwinLabs/orderform_draft_v1.pdf :link:

sasha-sales: Thanks everyone. Immediate asks for next steps:
- Julie: send redline for holdback + DPA alternative text (ETA EOD today?)
- Ryan: confirm whether finance will accept single invoice + net-60 with credit check (ETA tomorrow)
- Omar: confirm ops delta/cost if EU private KMS vs cloud KMS (ETA EOD)
I can do a quick exec note if we need signoff for net-60. :thumbsup:

julie-legal: Will draft redline now. If sales can get the customer to agree that EU entity signs a PO for EU spend, that's the cleanest. Otherwise we'll proceed with holdback appendix. Sending in ~5 hours.

ryan-finance: I'll run the credit check process and loop back by EOD tomorrow. If exec signoff required, ping me and I'll escalate.

omar-ops: I'll confirm the ops delta and update the cost table. Also will outline timeline impact for private KMS.

sasha-sales: Perfect. I'll update the order form with the suggested single-invoice fallback and attach Julie's redline when ready. tagging @julie-legal once she posts. :eyes:
